About Jared Gibbons
Which areas of Surrey should I look at for townhomes?

The main areas to look at are Guildford, Fleetwood, Cloverdale, Clayton, Newton, South Surrey, Panorama Ridge and Sullivan Heights. Each differs in lot sizes, the age of its homes and prices, and that is why I line the area up with your budget and commute.
What schools serve Surrey?
Surrey School District 36 covers the homes in this area. The address decides the catchment, so ask the district to confirm the specific school before you purchase.
How is transit and commuting from Surrey?
Transit choices are the RapidBus R1/R6 lines, plus the Surrey Langley SkyTrain, which is coming along Fraser Hwy, and SkyTrain on the Expo Line (King George to Scott Road).
What zoning rules affect townhomes in Surrey?
Many lots can now hold up to 3-4 units under Bill 44 small-scale multi-unit housing. As for detached lots, most are RF/RF-13/RF-10, which Surrey is folding into R-zones under its new Zoning Bylaw.
What should I check before buying a townhome in Surrey?
Strata title: check the depreciation report, roof and envelope history, strata fees, and parking rules. I review documents with you before subjects are removed.
Are first-time buyer exemptions available in Surrey?
Yes. A buyer who qualifies can take the federal FHSA and the First-Time Home Buyers' exemption from BC property transfer tax too; the current thresholds are laid out in my first-time buyer guide.
